settings.editor: The informational resources and external links provided below are intended for educational and support purposes only, and do not replace professional psychological care or medical advice. If you or someone you know is in acute distress or experiencing an immediate safety risk, please utilise the crisis contacts below or present to your nearest hospital emergency department.
Emergency Services · immediate danger or medical emergencies
Beyond Blue · 24/7 mental health information and advice
13YARN · 24/7 crisis support for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people
Suicide Call Back Service · 24/7 telephone and online counselling
DVConnect Womensline · 24/7 Queensland domestic violence and safety support
National Centre of Excellence for Complex Trauma support and resources
National support and information for eating disorders and body image concerns
Resources, guidance, and peer support forums for complex mental health
A free, Australian-developed mobile application offering evidence-based mindfulness practices to help ground the nervous system.
An interactive app created by Beyond Blue to help you easily build and keep a personal safety plan on your phone for times of high distress.
The National Centre for Excellence in Post-Traumatic Mental Health, providing evidence-based recovery information for individuals experiencing PTSD.
A fantastic state-based organisation providing community support, resources, and hope for individuals living with eating disorders and their support networks.
A federally funded body offering clean, evidence-based fact sheets about eating disorders.
A universally respected Australian initiative providing high-quality personality disorder resources, fact sheets, and guidebooks for individuals and families.
An introductory tool utilizing Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT) that clients can use independently to explore somatic grounding and lower acute physiological stress.
